role: Real API contract validation — compares a real set of expected endpoints against a real set of implemented endpoints, catching both missing endpoints and real, security-relevant undocumented extra endpoints.
behaviorDescription: validateContract() computes real set differences between expected and implemented endpoints, verified against exact-match, missing-endpoint, and extra-undocumented-endpoint cases before implementation. No LLM needed.
hardStops: Never suppresses an extra undocumented endpoint finding — a real security-relevant signal, always reported
